source.quote: Cayin's own page for the CS-100DAC, read 2026-11-25. The page is German. Specification rows: « DAC-Chipset: » « ES9038Pro (x2) »; « I2S: bis 32Bit/768kHz, DSD512 »; « USB: bis 32Bit/768kHz, DSD512 nativ, DoP256 »; « Roehrenbestueckung: » « 4 x 6922EH ». Description: « im nativen Modus bis zu 32 Bit / 768 kHz sowie DSD512 und DoP256 » and, listing the sockets, « USB-Audio, AES/EBU, BNC, Cinch, Toslink und I2S via Mini-HDMI » - with no rate given for AES/EBU, BNC, Cinch or Toslink. On filters: « Das gilt auch fuer die vielen unterschiedlichen Filter-Charakteristiken. » - many filter characteristics, no count and no names. The word NOS does not appear.

facts.chip: « ES9038Pro (x2) » (ESS). The « 4 x 6922EH » are OUTPUT TUBES - Cayin's signature - and not the converter.

_verification_des_conditions_faite: cayin.com has no terms-of-use page; its « Rechtliches » menu offers an Impressum, a cookie policy, AGB, payment, shipping, withdrawal and data protection. The AGB WAS READ - they are sales terms for the webshop - and carry no clause on copying, reproducing or extracting site content. The footer reads « Copyright: Cayin Audio Distribution GmbH », the ordinary notice. Worth stating: HiBy, read the same hour, forbids it outright.
_deux_entrees_notees_sur_six: « USB-Audio, AES/EBU, BNC, Cinch, Toslink und I2S via Mini-HDMI » - six sockets, and the specification rows rate exactly two of them, USB and I2S. AES/EBU, BNC, coaxial and optical get nothing. So four inputs exist on this device and this record says nothing about any of them, which is the honest outcome and not a gap to fill from the device figure.
_le_DoP_plafonne_une_marche_sous_le_nati: « USB: bis 32Bit/768kHz, DSD512 nativ, DoP256 ». Eighth maker to publish both halves, after APL HiFi, Matrix, Cambridge, LUMIN, Topping, Burson and Rotel. inputs.dop_max, registered this afternoon, takes the DoP256. The field has been in the schema for a few hours and is already on nine records.
_des_tubes_qui_ne_sont_PAS_le_convertiss: « Roehrenbestueckung: 4 x 6922EH ». Cayin builds tube-output DACs, and the valve count is the first thing a reader notices. It is the analogue output stage. The converter is the pair of ES9038Pro named two rows above. vocabulary/nos-means-two-things.json exists because of pages like this one - though here the maker never writes NOS at all, so the ambiguity does not arise.
